postal_system.legal_rule: Maldives Post provides the operational five-digit lookup. The September 2004 UPU sheet places five digits to the right of locality and records Malé-region and administrative-atoll prefix structures. These establish dated syntax and assignment evidence, not canonical polygons, exact civic addresses, building relations, complete history or blanket redistribution rights.
postal_system.assignment_rule: Every postcode is stored as a five-character digit string with leading zeroes preserved. A production assignment requires an exact current Maldives Post result with authority, island or locality, atoll or postal region, validity, retrieval time, response schema and digest pinned. UPU prefixes, LD Codes, FCodes, island names, equal names, post-office points, coordinates, boundary overlap and nearest features do not create a full postcode assignment, postal area or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No reviewed canonical national Maldives postcode polygon artifact is bundled. An official postal surface requires an exact postal-authority boundary artifact and five-digit code relation with authority, edition, coverage, rights, CRS, topology and digest pinned. Joining an exact postcode assignment to a permitted OneMap island or administrative boundary is a source-composed island administrative join surface, not a postal-authority polygon. Voronoi, interpolation and model surfaces remain derived and uncertainty-bearing; LD Codes, FCodes, Census GIS and OSM never become official postcode polygons.
postal_system.address_rule: Recipient, organization, house or building name, floor, apartment or unit, house number, street or magu, ward or locality, island or city, administrative atoll, postal-service object and five-digit postcode remain typed and validity-aware. Island and P.O. Box delivery mean street, house number and atoll are not universally present. A postcode, island ID, LD Code, FCode, Census row, coordinate or map label alone does not identify a recipient, owner, occupant, entrance, unit or exact legal civic address.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building display requires an explicit rights-cleared civic-address identifier, separately permitted building geometry, and a provider-defined stable relation, common identifier or reviewed explicit crosswalk. Land-registry surveys and OneMap features require exact permission; island containment, plot codes, house-name strings, coordinate equality, proximity and nearest-building logic are candidates or validation evidence only and never establish an exact address-building relation.
postal_system.licence_rule: Maldives Post, UPU, Geomatics Department, OneMap, ArcGIS services and Maldives Bureau of Statistics pages are reference evidence until exact reuse terms are recorded. Public viewer or service access and survey submission standards do not grant blanket row, layer, address, parcel or building redistribution rights. Statistics maps are informational, dynamic and require independent verification for legal, engineering, navigation or precision use.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Recipients, senders, P.O. Box holders, postcode and shipping query records, phones, emails, identity data, households, residents, owners, occupants, tenants, census microdata, land or building forms, parcel records, access credentials, tracking records and private premises are excluded from public artifacts. Only explicitly public or licensed non-personal aggregate fields may enter a production pack.
